items.summary: AMD Warp amd-integeration-dev ac540f59 hardcodes WP_TILE_WARP_SIZE 64 for every HIP target (warp/native/tile_reduce.h:14-18). On wave32 RDNA (gfx1100, W7800) tile_sum/tile_max/tile_reduce return wrong results for any block_dim > 32 (sum error 15-42 on sums of 64-256 unit normals); block_dim 32 and tile_matmul are correct. Isaac Lab's tested kitless paths are unaffected (no failing test; MuJoCo Warp qacc matches MuJoCo C across nv=24..96), but Newton IK, implicit MPM, Kamino, VBD and geometry kernels use tile reductions. Fix exists on amd-integration-halo (selects by __GFX9__). Draft F in projects/IsaacLab/notes.md.
